articles.author: Sebastian Strangio
articles.title: China Conducts Military Exercise in South China Sea After Confrontation at Disputed Shoal
articles.description: The "provisional understanding" between Beijing and Manila over the Philippine resupply of Second Thomas Shoal appears to have broken down.
